summary.plain: A stack of scintillators and wire chambers that stops pions, with a very large crystal calorimeter that measures the energies of the positrons from the two decay routes.
summary.technical: Plastic scintillator and wire-chamber pion tracking, an 8 mm scintillator stopping target and a large NaI(Tl) crystal calorimeter surrounded by CsI crystals, for the pi -> e nu / pi -> mu nu ratio.
